Aún no hay revisiones de tema. Se piden: No topic reviews yet. Ask for one from an entity page (Curation → Review this topic) or from «To review», which ranks the topics where a review pays off most.
Aún no hay temas: hace falta alguna enti: No topics yet: it takes an entity with at least two current facts.
Este brain tiene tantos hechos que solo: This brain has so many facts that only the most recent were read: the list may leave out older topics.
Las consultas son las de la muestra de c: Recalls are those in the recall sample of the last {{n}} days that brought one of its facts.
Las consultas son las veces que se recup: Recalls are the times one of its facts was recalled, without keeping the question's text (with the recall sample on, the sampled recalls are counted).
Las entidades donde una revisión de tema: The entities where a topic review pays off most, best first. What counts: how often they are recalled (it multiplies the rest), how many current facts they have, how many groups of repeated facts, what share of their facts is flagged (past their shelf life or refuted by their probe) and whether a retirement review waits. A reviewed topic drops down until new facts arrive. No AI call is made to rank them.
Una revisión de tema lee todo lo que la: A topic review reads everything the memory knows about an entity (its facts, the episodes that mention it and its neighbours' facts) and proposes what to invalidate, merge, rewrite and add, citing its evidence each time. Ask for one from the entity page, under Curation, or from «To review». A curator decides each action: approved, it becomes a correction, applied at once and undoable, or, for something missing, a proposal in the queue.
